- [LGRA.13.11] `emit` / `publish`: every non-nullable slot of the schema is
  given a value, except `ts`, which takes the instant of assertion
  ([LFAC.1.3.4]); the compiler must reject an action that omits one
  (`DS_VALIDATE_MISSING_SLOT`), naming the slot. A nullable slot the action
  omits takes `null` ([LNUL.11.1]).
